CustomField.description: If this is turned 'on', the system will determine if today's date is the last day of last month plus "Buffer_Days_For_System_Generated__c". If so, all the draft drives from last month will be processed for resource allocation. If this is turned 'off', resource allocation process will have to be handled manually via a button click.

CustomField.label: Automate System Generate Process
